edges.reason: msg.sender is the raw untrusted value returned by Context._msgSender.
ERC20.transfer calls _msgSender to resolve the token owner.
_msgSender returns the caller address that becomes owner in ERC20.transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom calls _msgSender to resolve the spender.
_msgSender result is used as spender in ERC20.transferFrom.
ERC20.approve calls _msgSender to resolve the allowance owner.
_msgSender result is used as owner in ERC20.approve.
ERC20.increaseAllowance calls _msgSender.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance calls _msgSender.
Pinnacle constructor calls _mint(initialAccount, initialBalance).
ERC20.transfer delegates the state change to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom spends allowance before transferring.
ERC20.transferFrom performs the token movement via _transfer.
ERC20.approve writes the allowance via _approve.
ERC20.increaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance writes the reduced allowance via _approve.
ERC20._spendAllowance reads current allowance via allowance().
ERC20._spendAllowance updates the allowance via _approve.
_transfer writes _balances[from] and _balances[to].
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
_mint credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
_burn debits _balances[account].
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_burn invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_burn invokes the _afterTokenTransfer hook.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender].
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
allowance reads _allowances[owner][spender].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
ERC20 constructor (invoked by Pinnacle constructor) sets _name.
ERC20 constructor (invoked by Pinnacle constructor) sets _symbol.
ERC20 constructor (invoked by Pinnacle constructor) sets _decimals to 18.
Address.sendValue transfers ETH to the caller-supplied recipient via a low-level call, handing control to an external address.
Address.functionCallWithValue performs a value-bearing low-level call to an arbitrary target, transferring control externally.
Address.functionStaticCall performs a read-only staticcall to an arbitrary target (no state-changing reentry possible).
Address.functionDelegateCall executes arbitrary target code in the current contract context via delegatecall.
Address.verifyCallResult bubbles revert data through an inline assembly revert.
functionCallWithValue delegates result verification to verifyCallResult.
functionStaticCall delegates result verification to verifyCallResult.
functionDelegateCall delegates result verification to verifyCallResult.
ERC20._transfer writes the new balance using an unchecked subtraction from the cached fromBalance.
The local fromBalance flows into the unchecked subtraction that produces the new _balances[from].
The untrusted recipient parameter is the external target of the low-level value call in sendValue.
The amount parameter is sent as call value to the external recipient, enabling value-based reentrancy.
The constructor parameter initialAccount is passed directly into _mint as the beneficiary.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter is a pure pass-through argument of the core function _mint, so it can be merged into the mint call site.
The recipient parameter only exists to drive the core sendValue function's external value transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The amount parameter is consumed solely as the value of the unsafe low-level call, so it normalizes into that unsafe operation.
The fromBalance local is a short-lived cached copy of _balances[from] used only inside the core _transfer function.
